title: Shortest Way to Form String
description: Given two lowercase strings `source` and `target`, return the minimum number of subsequences of `source` such that their concatenation equals `target`. If `target` cannot be formed this way, return `-1`.
constraints: source and target consist of lowercase English letters.
hints: If target contains any character that never appears in source, return -1 immediately.
Precompute nextPos[i][c]: the earliest index >= i in source where character c occurs (or -1). Greedily match as many target characters as possible in each pass over source.

examples.explanation: "abcbc" can be formed as "ab" + "cbc" (2 subsequences of "abc").
'd' does not appear in "abc", so return -1.
